```{r}
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, ".unaltraweb", "computations.yml"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")
    }
    path <- parent
  }
}

root <- find_project_root(getwd())
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(sf))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))

gpkg <- file.path(root, "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/processed/tarragones-boundaries-icgc-20260120.gpkg")
municipalities <- sf::st_read(gpkg, layer = "municipalities_250k", quiet = TRUE)
county <- sf::st_read(gpkg, layer = "comarca_250k", quiet = TRUE)
seats <- sf::st_read(gpkg, layer = "municipality_seats", quiet = TRUE)
indicators <- read.csv(
  file.path(root, "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/processed/municipal-indicators-tarragones-2021.csv"),
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

municipalities$CODIMUNI <- as.character(municipalities$CODIMUNI)
seats$CODIMUNI <- as.character(seats$CODIMUNI)
indicators$mun_code <- as.character(indicators$mun_code)
indicators$mun_code <- ifelse(nchar(indicators$mun_code) == 5, paste0("0", indicators$mun_code), indicators$mun_code)
d <- merge(municipalities, indicators, by.x = "CODIMUNI", by.y = "mun_code", all.x = TRUE)
seat_data <- merge(seats, indicators, by.x = "CODIMUNI", by.y = "mun_code", all.x = TRUE)
seat_xy <- sf::st_coordinates(sf::st_cast(seat_data, "POINT"))
seat_data$x <- seat_xy[, 1]
seat_data$y <- seat_xy[, 2]

stopifnot(
  nrow(d) == 22,
  nrow(seat_data) == 22,
  !anyNA(d$housing_non_main_pct),
  !anyNA(seat_data$housing_total),
  all(d$indicator_status == "ok")
)

palette_blue <- c("#edf8fb", "#b3dce8", "#66b2c9", "#2b83ba", "#155b8a")
bbox <- sf::st_bbox(county)

map_theme <- theme_void(base_family = "DejaVu Sans") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, color = "#17202a", hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 19, color = "#52616b", hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#f8fafc", color = "#d8e0e6", linewidth = 0.55),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

choropleth <- ggplot(d) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = housing_non_main_pct), color = "#ffffff", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_sf(data = county, fill = NA, color = "#36454f", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colors = palette_blue, limits = range(d$housing_non_main_pct)) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA, xlim = c(bbox["xmin"], bbox["xmax"]), ylim = c(bbox["ymin"], bbox["ymax"])) +
  labs(title = "Coropleta", subtitle = "Color = % no principal") +
  map_theme

proportional <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = d, fill = "#edf1f4", color = "#aeb9c2", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(
    data = sf::st_drop_geometry(seat_data),
    aes(x = x, y = y, size = housing_total),
    shape = 21, fill = "#e76f51", color = "#8f3024", stroke = 0.45, alpha = 0.80
  ) +
  geom_sf(data = county, fill = NA, color = "#36454f", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 16) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA, xlim = c(bbox["xmin"], bbox["xmax"]), ylim = c(bbox["ymin"], bbox["ymax"])) +
  labs(title = "Símbols proporcionals", subtitle = "Àrea = habitatges totals") +
  map_theme

point_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = d, fill = "#edf1f4", color = "#c5ced5", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_point(
    data = sf::st_drop_geometry(seat_data), aes(x = x, y = y),
    shape = 21, size = 3.0, fill = "#6a51a3", color = "white", stroke = 0.55
  ) +
  geom_sf(data = county, fill = NA, color = "#36454f", linewidth = 0.5) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA, xlim = c(bbox["xmin"], bbox["xmax"]), ylim = c(bbox["ymin"], bbox["ymax"])) +
  labs(title = "Mapa puntual", subtitle = "Posició = 22 capitals") +
  map_theme

pie_sector <- function(cx, cy, radius, start, end, group, category) {
  angles <- seq(start, end, length.out = max(12, ceiling(abs(end - start) * 24)))
  data.frame(
    x = c(cx, cx + radius * cos(angles), cx),
    y = c(cy, cy + radius * sin(angles), cy),
    group = group,
    category = category
  )
}

selected_codes <- c("431482", "439057", "431711", "431536")
selected <- sf::st_drop_geometry(seat_data[match(selected_codes, seat_data$CODIMUNI), ])
selected$display_x <- c(356000, 342200, 341800, 369000)
selected$display_y <- c(4550700, 4549800, 4555700, 4557600)
selected$short_name <- c("TGN", "Salou", "Vila-\nseca", "Torre-\ndembarra")

pie_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(selected)), function(i) {
  ratio <- selected$housing_non_main[i] / selected$housing_total[i]
  split <- -pi / 2 + 2 * pi * ratio
  rbind(
    pie_sector(selected$display_x[i], selected$display_y[i], 1550, -pi / 2, split, paste0(i, "-non"), "No principal"),
    pie_sector(selected$display_x[i], selected$display_y[i], 1550, split, 3 * pi / 2, paste0(i, "-main"), "Principal")
  )
}))

cartodiagram <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = d, fill = "#edf1f4", color = "#c5ced5", linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_segment(
    data = selected,
    aes(x = x, y = y, xend = display_x, yend = display_y),
    color = "#8d99a3", linewidth = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_polygon(
    data = pie_data,
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = group, fill = category),
    color = "white", linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = selected,
    aes(x = display_x, y = display_y - 2050, label = short_name),
    family = "DejaVu Sans", size = 6.8, color = "#36454f"
  ) +
  geom_sf(data = county, fill = NA, color = "#36454f", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("No principal" = "#2a9d8f", "Principal" = "#d8e0e6")) +
  coord_sf(datum = NA, xlim = c(bbox["xmin"], bbox["xmax"]), ylim = c(bbox["ymin"], bbox["ymax"])) +
  labs(title = "Cartodiagrama", subtitle = "Verd = no principal | gris = principal") +
  map_theme

methods_output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/thematic-cartography/thematic-methods-tarragones-2021.svg")
dir.create(dirname(methods_output), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
svglite::svglite(methods_output, width = 11.5, height = 9.6, bg = "white")
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.rect(gp = grid::gpar(fill = "white", col = NA))
methods_layout <- grid::grid.layout(
  nrow = 3,
  ncol = 2,
  heights = grid::unit(c(0.16, 0.42, 0.42), "npc"),
  widths = grid::unit(c(0.5, 0.5), "npc")
)
grid::pushViewport(grid::viewport(layout = methods_layout))
grid::grid.text(
  "Quatre mètodes, quatre preguntes territorials",
  x = grid::unit(0.03, "npc"), y = grid::unit(0.68, "npc"), just = c("left", "center"),
  vp = grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1:2),
  gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = "DejaVu Sans", fontsize = 22, fontface = "bold", col = "#17202a")
)
grid::grid.text(
  "Mateix territori; cada mètode respon una pregunta diferent.",
  x = grid::unit(0.03, "npc"), y = grid::unit(0.27, "npc"), just = c("left", "center"),
  vp = grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 1, layout.pos.col = 1:2),
  gp = grid::gpar(fontfamily = "DejaVu Sans", fontsize = 19, col = "#52616b")
)
print(choropleth, vp = grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 2, layout.pos.col = 1))
print(proportional, vp = grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 2, layout.pos.col = 2))
print(point_map, vp = grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 3, layout.pos.col = 1))
print(cartodiagram, vp = grid::viewport(layout.pos.row = 3, layout.pos.col = 2))
grDevices::dev.off()
```
